# AWS Security Hub

Store regional Security Hub hubs, standard subscriptions, ASFF findings, custom insights and action targets over REST JSON without security evaluation.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `securityhub` |
| Signing name | `securityhub` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2018-10-26` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 23 of 123 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-security-hub) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Members, invitations, administrators, organization configuration, automation rules, configuration policies, product integrations/subscriptions and finding aggregation are not implemented.
- No standard/security controls, control enablement, AWS Config rules, compliance evaluation or service-linked behavior. CloudFormation DisabledStandardsControls is unsupported.
- EventBridge delivery of imported findings and custom action target invocation are future work.
- ASFF stores only whitelisted fields; resource details and other unsupported members fail explicitly. DateRange, other filter fields/comparisons, resource sort fields, other insight grouping attributes, Providers and StandardsInput are unsupported.
- Only hubs support tags within this scope. Catalogue excludes newer standards and does not simulate regional availability or asynchronous readiness.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.
